summary: RestrictedDatePicker feature testing complete - 8 of 9 tests PASSED. Commission Income form does NOT use RestrictedDatePicker for Yearly/Quarterly/Half-Yearly frequencies (uses native dropdown instead).

ui_bugs.issue: Uses native <select> dropdown (1-31) for date selection instead of RestrictedDatePicker. This is inconsistent with other income forms (Dividend, Business, Rental, Interest) which all use RestrictedDatePicker.

dividend_monthly_unrestricted.test: DividendIncome Monthly: Calendar should have unrestricted navigation
dividend_monthly_unrestricted.evidence: Calendar shows navigation arrows and month/year dropdowns. Navigation buttons found: 3

dividend_quarterly_restricted.test: DividendIncome Quarterly: After selecting Q1 and January, calendar shows ONLY January

dividend_half_yearly_restricted.test: DividendIncome Half-Yearly: After selecting H1 and March, calendar shows ONLY March
dividend_half_yearly_restricted.evidence: Calendar shows 'March 2026' with restricted navigation, date selected: March 20th, 2026

dividend_yearly_restricted.test: DividendIncome Yearly: After selecting August, calendar shows ONLY August dates
dividend_yearly_restricted.evidence: Calendar shows 'August 2026', no navigation arrows visible, date selected: August 15th, 2026

dividend_irregular_unrestricted.test: DividendIncome Irregular: Calendar should have unrestricted navigation

business_income_yearly_restricted.test: BusinessIncome Yearly: Calendar restricted to selected month

rental_income_yearly_restricted.test: RentalIncome Yearly: Calendar restricted to selected month (December)
rental_income_yearly_restricted.evidence: Calendar shows 'December 2026' with no navigation buttons, uses RestrictedDatePicker

commission_income_yearly_uses_dropdown.evidence: Uses native SELECT dropdown (tagName: SELECT, type: select-one) instead of RestrictedDatePicker button. This is inconsistent with other income forms.

interest_income_yearly_restricted.test: InterestIncome Yearly: Calendar restricted to selected month

action_items: CommissionIncome.js: Replace native <select> dropdown with RestrictedDatePicker for Yearly, Quarterly, and Half-Yearly frequencies to maintain consistency with other income forms (Dividend, Business, Rental, Interest)
critical_code_review_comments: CommissionIncome.js uses native select dropdown (days 1-31) for date selection, while all other income forms use RestrictedDatePicker calendar component
All other income forms (DividendIncome, BusinessIncome, RentalIncome, InterestIncome) correctly implement RestrictedDatePicker with month restriction
RestrictedDatePicker component properly hides navigation arrows when restrictedMonth prop is set
getMonthIndex() helper function correctly converts month name to 0-based index
